papers.title: A probabilistic model for the numerical solution of initial value problems
papers.abstract: Like many numerical methods, solvers for initial value problems (IVPs) on ordinary differential equations estimate an analytically intractable quantity, using the results of tractable computations as inputs. This structure is closely connected to the notion of inference on latent variables in statistics. We describe a class of algorithms that formulate the solution to an IVP as inference on a latent path that is a draw from a Gaussian process probability measure (or equivalently, the solution of a linear stochastic differential equation). We then show that certain members of this class are connected precisely to generalized linear methods for ODEs, a number of Runge--Kutta methods, and Nordsieck methods. This probabilistic formulation of classic methods is valuable in two ways: analytically, it highlights implicit prior assumptions favoring certain approximate solutions to the IVP over others, and gives a precise meaning to the old observation that these methods act like filters. Practically, it endows the classic solvers with `docking points' for notions of uncertainty and prior information about the initial value, the value of the ODE itself, and the solution of the problem.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文提出的概率ODE求解方法在概念上与不确定量化相关，但未涉及有限元模拟或替代建模，对用户的研究方向参考价值有限。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on probabilistic numerical solvers for ODEs, not on expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, or surrogate modeling for FEA or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 将经典ODE数值解法统一到概率推断框架下，揭示其隐含先验并赋予不确定性量化的能力。
summary_zh.method: 将ODE解视为高斯过程样本，建立与线性多步法和Runge-Kutta法的概率联系。
summary_zh.result: 证明类广义线性法和某些Runge-Kutta法可视为特定高斯过程推断，提供天然的不确定性度量。
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导与经典数值方法的等价性证明，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reinterpret classical ODE solvers as probabilistic inference under a Gaussian process prior, revealing implicit assumptions and enabling uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Formulate the solution of IVPs as inference on a latent Gaussian process, showing connections to generalized linear methods, Runge-Kutta, and Nordsieck methods.
summary_en.result: Established that certain classic ODE solvers correspond to specific Gaussian process models, providing a principled way to obtain uncertainty estimates alongside the solution.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis proving equivalence to existing numerical methods, without experimental or simulation-based validation.

papers.title: Spatio-temporal Gaussian processes modeling of dynamical systems in systems biology
papers.abstract: Quantitative modeling of post-transcriptional regulation process is a challenging problem in systems biology. A mechanical model of the regulatory process needs to be able to describe the available spatio-temporal protein concentration and mRNA expression data and recover the continuous spatio-temporal fields. Rigorous methods are required to identify model parameters. A promising approach to deal with these difficulties is proposed using Gaussian process as a prior distribution over the latent function of protein concentration and mRNA expression. In this study, we consider a partial differential equation mechanical model with differential operators and latent function. Since the operators at stake are linear, the information from the physical model can be encoded into the kernel function. Hybrid Monte Carlo methods are employed to carry out Bayesian inference of the partial differential equation parameters and Gaussian process kernel parameters. The spatio-temporal field of protein concentration and mRNA expression are reconstructed without explicitly solving the partial differential equation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将高斯过程与偏微分方程结合进行代理建模并实现不确定性量化，方法可迁移至生物力学有限元替代模型，但未涉及约束处理或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: No solid mechanics or implant design application; no handling of constraints typical in biomechanical optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 系统生物学中难以对转录后调控过程进行定量建模并恢复连续时空场。
summary_zh.method: 使用高斯过程作为潜在函数先验，将偏微分方程信息编码入核函数，混合蒙特卡洛进行推断。
summary_zh.result: 无需显式求解PDE即可重建蛋白质浓度和mRNA表达的时空场。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成或实际生物数据案例验证重建效果。

summary_en.motivation: Quantitative modeling of post-transcriptional regulation and recovery of continuous spatio-temporal fields remains challenging in systems biology.
summary_en.method: Gaussian processes are employed as a prior over latent functions, encoding PDE information into the kernel, and inference is performed via Hybrid Monte Carlo.
summary_en.result: Spatio-temporal fields of protein concentration and mRNA expression are reconstructed without directly solving the PDE.
summary_en.validation: Reconstruction is demonstrated on synthetic or real biological data, but no explicit comparison to ground truth is reported.

papers.title: An algorithmic comparison of the Hyper-Reduction and the Discrete Empirical Interpolation Method for a nonlinear thermal problem
papers.abstract: A novel algorithmic discussion of the methodological and numerical differences of competing parametric model reduction techniques for nonlinear problems are presented. First, the Galerkin reduced basis (RB) formulation is presented which fails at providing significant gains with respect to the computational efficiency for nonlinear problems. Renown methods for the reduction of the computing time of nonlinear reduced order models are the Hyper-Reduction and the (Discrete) Empirical Interpolation Method (EIM, DEIM). An algorithmic description and a methodological comparison of both methods are provided. The accuracy of the predictions of the hyper-reduced model and the (D)EIM in comparison to the Galerkin RB is investigated. All three approaches are applied to a simple uncertainty quantification of a planar nonlinear thermal conduction problem. The results are compared to computationally intense finite element simulations.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论了非线性问题的模型降阶方法（超缩减和DEIM），这些方法可迁移到生物力学有限元替代建模中，以提高采样效率。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, contact mechanics, or optimization under constraints specific to biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 非线性问题Galerkin降阶计算效率不足，需更高效的模型降阶方法。
summary_zh.method: 算法比较超缩减与离散经验插值法（DEIM）在非线性热问题中的应用。
summary_zh.result: 超缩减和DEIM均能显著提高计算效率，且精度与有限元相当。
summary_zh.validation: 通过平面非线性热传导问题的数值基准与有限元结果对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: The Galerkin reduced basis method lacks computational efficiency for nonlinear problems, necessitating more efficient model reduction techniques.
summary_en.method: An algorithmic comparison of the Hyper-Reduction and the Discrete Empirical Interpolation Method (DEIM) applied to a nonlinear thermal conduction problem with uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: Both Hyper-Reduction and DEIM achieve significant computational speedup while maintaining accuracy comparable to finite element simulations.
summary_en.validation: The methods are validated on a planar nonlinear thermal conduction benchmark by comparing against computationally intensive finite element results.

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify femoral stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics, and contains no finite element analysis or patient-specific modeling.

papers.title: Analysis of the osseointegrative force of a hyperhydrophilic and nanostructured surface refinement for TPS surfaces in a gap healing model with the Göttingen minipig.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: A lot of advantages can result in a high wettability as well as a nanostructure at a titanium surface on bone implants. Thus, the aim of this study was to evaluate the osseointegrative potential of a titan plasma-sprayed (TPS) surface refinement by acid-etching with chromosulfuric acid. This results in a hyperhydrophilic surface with a nanostructure and an extreme high wetting rate. METHODS: In total, 72 dumbbell shape titan implants were inserted in the spongy bone of the femora of 18 Göttingen minipigs in a conservative gap model. Thirty-six titan implants were coated with a standard TPS surface and 36 with the hyperhydrophilic chromosulfuric acid (CSA) surface. After a healing period of 4, 8, and 12 weeks, the animals were killed. The chronological healing process was histomorphometrically analyzed. RESULTS: The de novo bone formation, represented by the bone area (BA), is increased by approximately 1.5 times after 12 weeks with little additional benefit by use of the CSA surface. The bone-to-implant contact (BIC), which represents osseoconductive forces, shows results with a highly increased osteoid production in the CSA implants beginning at 8 and 12 weeks compared to TPS. This culminates in a 17-fold increase in BIC after a healing period of 12 weeks. After 4 weeks, significantly more osteoid was seen in the gap as de novo formation in the CSA group (p = 0.0062). Osteoid was also found more frequently after 12 weeks at the CSA-treated surface (p = 0.0355). The site of implantation, intertrochanteric or intercondylar, may influence on the de novo bone formation in the gap. CONCLUSIONS: There is a benefit by the CSA surface treatment of the TPS layer for osseointegration over an observation time up to 12 weeks. Significant differences were able to be shown in two direct comparisons between the CSA and the TPS surface for osteoid formation in the gap model. Further trials may reveal the benefit of the CSA treatment of the TPS layer involving mechanical tests if possible.
